discription: A basic frequency modulation synth with an ADSR envelope.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, modFreq=200, modIndex=10; var car, mod, env; env = EnvGen.ar( Env.adsr(0.01, 0.1, 0.8, 1.0, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2 ); mod = SinOsc.ar(modFreq) * modIndex; car = SinOsc.ar(freq + mod); Out.ar(out, (car * amp * env) ! 2); }
